api.title: Translation API
api.description: RESTful API with tiered access (Free/Startup/Business/Enterprise), quota management, usage analytics, and developer dashboard. Enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure.

nlp.title: NLP Toolkit
nlp.description: Open-source Sango language processing: tokenizer, language detection, stemmer, and morphological analysis. Available as a published open-source package.

model.title: Language Models
model.description: Vocabulary-augmented prompting with foundation AI — no fine-tuning required. Several-hundred-word verified Sango lexicon (Sango-French-English). Methodology and dataset published openly for the AI research community.

deploy.title: Deployment Proof
deploy.description: eNdara WhatsApp learning bot live on Meta Platform since April 2026. Real-world deployment serving users across Central Africa. Proof that our AI works beyond the browser.

roadmap.sectionDescription: Starting with Sango. Expanding to 6 languages covering 250M+ speakers. The same infrastructure scales to every African language.

research.sectionTitle: Infrastructure for the open AI commons
research.sectionDescription: Every resource MEYNG builds for Sango is published free under open licenses — for researchers, NGOs, and governments worldwide.

model.title: First Open Sango Translation Model
model.description: Fine-tuned on 500,000+ French-Sango sentence pairs. BENCH-001: +41% BLEU vs baseline. The first open neural machine translation model for Sango — free for non-commercial use (CC-BY-NC 4.0).

dataset.title: Sango Vocabulary Dataset
dataset.description: Hundreds of Sango entries with French and English translations, pronunciation guides, and grammar context. The only structured Sango lexical dataset in any open repository.

npm.title: Sango NLP Toolkit
npm.description: Open-source tokenizer, language detector, and stemmer for Sango. Published on npm. Diacritic-aware by design — handles the 8 tonal diacritics of the Sango orthography.

values.sectionDescription: We're not competing in a crowded market. We're creating a new one — AI infrastructure for the most underserved languages on Earth.

firstMover.title: Beyond Translation
firstMover.description: General-purpose translators handle words. SangoAI handles the language — specialized grammar rules, domain accuracy, verified vocabulary, native speaker audio, and a full learning platform. Where surface translation ends, SangoAI infrastructure begins.

production.title: Production, Not Research
production.description: Live API serving real requests. Published models and datasets. WhatsApp bot deployed on a global messaging platform. This isn't a paper — it's infrastructure you can integrate today.

scalable.title: Built to Scale
scalable.description: The same architecture that powers Sango scales to any language. Swahili, Lingala, Wolof — each new language is infrastructure, not a rebuild. 2,000+ languages await.

about.sectionTitle: The AI Infrastructure Company for African Languages
about.sectionDescription: We build the translation APIs, NLP tools, and language models that enable organizations to operate in African languages at scale.
about.missionDescription: To build production-grade AI infrastructure for every African language — starting with the most underserved. We believe the next billion internet users will speak languages that AI doesn't understand yet. MEYNG is building the bridge.
about.visionDescription: A future where every African language has production-quality NLP tools — translation APIs, speech recognition, and language models — accessible to any developer, organization, or government that needs them.
about.whyDescription: Africa has 2,000+ languages spoken by 1.4 billion people. Less than 5% have basic NLP tools. Google Translate supports 134+ languages — fewer than 25 are African, and most with limited depth. The gap between basic translation coverage and production-grade language infrastructure is where MEYNG operates. This isn't a niche. It's the largest untapped market in language AI.
whyPoints: First dedicated infrastructure for most languages

technical.title: Technical Moat
technical.description: Community-verified vocabulary database, published vocabulary-augmented prompting methodology, and production infrastructure that took years to build. The moat is data quality and cultural authority — not just compute.

cultural.title: Cultural Authority
cultural.description: Founded by a Central African native speaker with deep linguistic expertise. Our data quality comes from cultural understanding, not just computation.

firstMover.title: First-Mover Lock-In
firstMover.description: First to publish Sango NLP tools, first to deploy a Sango AI API, first to ship a WhatsApp bot for Sango learning. Network effects compound.

partnerships.title: Strategic Positioning
partnerships.description: Built on world-class foundation models, published openly for AI community visibility, deployed on the world's largest messaging platform for maximum reach across Africa.

founder.name: Michel WENEZOUI
founder.bio: Software engineer and AI entrepreneur. Native Sango speaker from the Central African Republic. Built SangoAI from zero to production — scalable cloud infrastructure, published NLP toolkit, native speaker audio program, and vocabulary-augmented prompting research. Invited by BPI France to Africa Forward Summit, Nairobi 2026. Based in Paris.

founded.title: MEYNG Founded
founded.description: Incorporated in Paris. Began building the first Sango NLP pipeline and training data collection.

sangoaiLaunch.title: SangoAI Goes Live
sangoaiLaunch.description: Production API deployed on cloud infrastructure. Translation, chat, and learning platform launched at sangoai.sbs with enterprise-grade scalability.

apiPublished.title: AI Assets Published
apiPublished.description: Open-source NLP toolkit published for developers. Vocabulary-augmented prompting methodology and verified Sango lexicon released openly. Sango becomes a documented NLP research language.

metaLive.title: WhatsApp Bot on Meta Platform
metaLive.description: eNdara learning bot published on Meta. Any WhatsApp user can message to learn Sango. First real-world deployment proof beyond web.

hfPublished.title: Research Published
hfPublished.description: Vocabulary-augmented prompting methodology and verified Sango lexicon published openly. Sango becomes a documented NLP research language with an open, reusable dataset for the global research community.

nativeAudio.title: Native Speaker Audio Program
nativeAudio.description: First native Sango speaker recordings live in production. Phase 1: 12 words. Phase 2: 300-word recording program underway. First AI platform for Sango with authentic pronunciation — not machine-generated speech.

nairobiSummit.title: Africa Forward Summit — Nairobi
nairobiSummit.description: Selected by BPI France to attend Africa Forward Summit, Nairobi. Strategic conversations with government officials, NGO partners, and institutional investors across the continent. The language infrastructure story reaches decision-makers.

about.ctaDescription: We're raising pre-seed funding to scale from 1 language to 5, hire our first NLP engineers, and close our first enterprise contracts. The market is massive, the timing is now.
